# Future Ammunition - Anti-Drone

`jmfsb_fa_antidrone`

Cycles the local player's Mk364 airburst range through the presets. Bound to a CBA keybind (registered in fnc_initAntiDrone) and mirrored by the ACE self-interaction menu (see CfgVehicles.hpp).
